notes: Layered finish for Duo-Band nebulae: StarNet separates the stars first, the nebula and sky are finished on the starless layer (frame-edge glow flattened, nebula lifted and denoised, smoother sky, brick-red Hα, or a HOO palette), and tighter stars are screened back. On C 33 it beat the DWARF's own picture on contrast, flatness and neutral sky.
